pattern: Submit a task result without accepting the requirement
experience: An agent submits its own participant result while another participant is still running. It must not mark the requirement accepted or stop peers.
rule: work_item_submit records a participant delivery for user review; completion of one execution does not accept the task.
prompt: Your execution execution-ui for task task-1 revision 1 has completed its assigned UI work. The API participant is still running. Submit the UI result with summary "UI implemented and keyboard navigation verified" and artifact src/TaskBoard.tsx. Do not accept the requirement or stop the API participant.
